# A loop of Midtown Manhattan blocks, at walking pace
#
# lat lon, one point per line, about 2.8 m apart: at 2 s per point that is 1.4 m/s.
# 7th Ave from W 34th to W 38th St, W 38th to 6th Ave, 6th Ave down to W 34th, and
# W 34th back to 7th Ave. 1186 m, 427 points.
#
# ⚠ FOR STUDYING WALKNYC, NOT FOR BRUMA (2026-10-06). The project lead asked to
# see WalkNYC's walk replay, which needs a walk recorded in New York. Corners are
# hand-placed on the avenues to within a few tens of metres. Nothing here is content.
#
#     ANDROID_SERIAL=emulator-5554 bash tools/replay-route.sh tools/routes/manhattan-midtown.txt 2
